problem:
Select the missing parts in a particular solution of the differential equation ${y}^{″}+25y=f(x),$ where the Fourier series of the $2$-periodic forcing function is given by

$$
f(x)∼{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{(-1)^{n}}{{n}^{2}\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡(n\pi x).
$$

*Hint: You may assume that the free term and all the cosine coefficients in the Fourier series of the particular solution are equal to zero.*

The Fourier series of a particular solution is

$$
{y}_{p}∼{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\,{{field-1}}\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡(n\pi x)
$$
